note: items are encoded(session, **session_data) exactly: id, then session_data keys, ending with the five session_capabilities keys (can_manage, can_close, can_activate, can_reschedule, can_record_attendance).

errors.note: Only reached with a valid CSRF token (a browser session always has one). A bare unauthenticated POST gets the CSRF 403 first.

errors.when: CSRF header missing or wrong (also an unauthenticated POST without a token)
errors.note: Django CsrfViewMiddleware answers with its HTML 403 page (no CSRF_FAILURE_VIEW). It runs before the endpoint, so it is also what an unauthenticated POST without a token gets instead of 401. CTMServerList treats any non-JSON error as a generic failure (Retry row) and never parses the body.

errors.when: page not an integer from 1 to 1000000 (also the string "1", true, 1.5)

messages: page must be an integer from 1 to 1000000.

errors.when: size not an integer from 1 to 100 (also the string "50", true, 1.5)

messages: size must be an integer from 1 to 100.

errors.when: sort field not allowed for this list and role
more than 3 sort entries or dir not asc/desc

messages: Use up to 3 sort entries, each with dir asc or desc.

errors.when: q shorter than 2 or longer than 200 characters after trimming (empty is allowed)

messages: Search text must be 2 to 200 characters.

errors.when: filter key not allowed for this list and role
filters.view not current, upcoming or archived

messages: view must be current, upcoming or archived.

errors.when: filters.ids not a list of 1 to 100 UUIDs, filters.case not a UUID, filters.part not 1 or 2, filters.state not a list of 1 to 3 of draft|planned|closed

extra_requests.returns: sessions holding an agenda item of that case with that part, newest date first; each item also has agenda_item_id and agenda_item_part
